name: Weak Hashing Algorithm
description: Detects the use of weak hashing algorithms.
recommendation: Use bcrypt or Argon2 instead.

name: Hardcoded Password
description: Detects hardcoded passwords within source code.
recommendation: Store credentials securely using environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Potential SQL Injection
description: Detects SQL query strings concatenated with dynamic values.
recommendation: Use parameterised queries or prepared statements.

name: Use of eval()
description: Detects the use of JavaScript eval().
recommendation: Avoid eval() and use safer alternatives.

name: Operating System Command Execution
description: Detects the use of child_process functions that execute operating system commands.
recommendation: Validate all user input and avoid executing operating system commands unless absolutely necessary.

name: Hardcoded API Key
description: Detects API keys or access tokens assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store API keys and access tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Unsafe document.write()
description: Detects use of document.write(), which can introduce cross-site scripting risks.
recommendation: Avoid document.write() and use safe DOM manipulation methods.

name: User Input Assigned to innerHTML
description: Detects request or browser input being assigned directly to innerHTML.
recommendation: Sanitise untrusted input and prefer textContent or safe rendering APIs.

name: Potential Path Traversal
description: Detects file reads that use request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain user-controlled file paths to approved directories.

name: JWT Decode Without Verification
description: Detects JWT decoding without cryptographic signature verification.
recommendation: Use jwt.verify() and validate the token signature and expected claims.

name: Disabled TLS Certificate Validation
description: Detects TLS configuration that disables certificate validation.
recommendation: Enable TLS certificate validation and trust only approved certificate authorities.

name: Prototype Pollution from Request Input
description: Detects request-controlled objects being merged directly into application objects.
recommendation: Allowlist permitted properties before merging user-controlled objects.

name: Dynamic Module Loading
description: Detects modules being dynamically loaded using request-controlled input.
recommendation: Never construct module paths from user input; use an allowlist of approved modules.

name: Open Redirect from User Input
description: Detects redirects using a destination obtained directly from request input.
recommendation: Validate redirect targets against an allowlist of trusted destinations.

name: Wildcard CORS Origin
description: Detects CORS configuration allowing requests from any origin.
recommendation: Restrict CORS access to explicitly trusted origins.

name: Insecure Cookie Configuration
description: Detects cookies explicitly configured without the Secure attribute.
recommendation: Set Secure on authentication and session cookies when using HTTPS.

name: Weak bcrypt Cost Factor
description: Detects bcrypt hashing configured with an insufficient work factor.
recommendation: Use an appropriate bcrypt cost factor, typically 10 or greater.

name: Shell Execution Enabled
description: Detects child process execution configured to run through a system shell.
recommendation: Avoid shell execution where possible and strictly validate command arguments.

name: Unsafe Object Deserialization
description: Detects use of unserialize() methods that may execute attacker-controlled object data.
recommendation: Avoid unsafe object deserialization and use validated data-only formats such as JSON.

name: Hardcoded Private Key
description: Detects private key material embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store private keys outside source control using a secure secrets manager.

name: HTTP Basic Authentication Header
description: Detects manually constructed Basic authentication headers.
recommendation: Prefer token-based authentication and ensure credentials are never embedded in source code.

name: Unsafe YAML Loading
description: Detects potentially unsafe YAML deserialization functions.
recommendation: Use safe YAML parsing with schema restrictions and validated input.

name: Hardcoded Database Password
description: Detects database password values assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store database credentials in environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Hardcoded JWT Secret
description: Detects JWT signing secrets assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store JWT signing secrets securely outside source code.

name: Disabled CSRF Protection
description: Detects configuration explicitly disabling CSRF protection.
recommendation: Enable CSRF protections for state-changing browser requests.

name: Permissive CSP Wildcard
description: Detects Content Security Policy directives allowing unrestricted sources.
recommendation: Restrict CSP directives to explicitly trusted origins.

name: Unsafe Temporary File Path
description: Detects hardcoded temporary file paths that may introduce insecure file handling.
recommendation: Use secure temporary-file APIs with randomized filenames and appropriate permissions.

name: Permissive File Permissions
description: Detects files created with globally writable permissions.
recommendation: Use least-privilege file permissions and avoid globally writable files.

name: MD5 Password Hashing
description: Detects MD5 hashing used in password-related code.
recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, or another password-specific hashing algorithm.

name: SHA1 Password Hashing
description: Detects SHA-1 hashing used in password-related code.
recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, or another password-specific hashing algorithm.

name: Unvalidated Dynamic Redirect
description: Detects redirects using variables commonly associated with user-controlled URLs.
recommendation: Validate redirect destinations against an allowlist of trusted locations.

name: Disabled HTTP Security Headers
description: Detects Helmet middleware configured with security protections explicitly disabled.
recommendation: Keep appropriate HTTP security headers enabled unless there is a documented requirement.

name: Insecure TLS Version
description: Detects TLS configuration allowing deprecated protocol versions.
recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 for encrypted communications.

name: Weak AES Mode
description: Detects use of AES in ECB mode.
recommendation: Use an authenticated encryption mode such as AES-GCM.

name: Hardcoded Encryption Key
description: Detects encryption keys assigned directly in source code.
recommendation: Store encryption keys in a secure secrets manager.

name: Unsafe execSync()
description: Detects synchronous operating system command execution.
recommendation: Avoid direct command execution and strictly validate all command arguments.

name: Unsafe spawn with Shell
description: Detects child process spawning with shell execution enabled.
recommendation: Disable shell execution and pass validated arguments directly to the spawned process.

name: Unsafe Dynamic Function
description: Detects use of the Function constructor for dynamic code execution.
recommendation: Avoid dynamically constructing executable JavaScript.

name: Potential NoSQL Injection
description: Detects request input passed directly into common database query filters.
recommendation: Validate and allowlist request fields before constructing database queries.

name: Unsafe JSON Web Token Algorithm
description: Detects JWT verification allowing the none algorithm.
recommendation: Allow only approved cryptographic JWT algorithms.

name: Missing HTTPOnly Cookie Flag
description: Detects cookies explicitly configured without HttpOnly protection.
recommendation: Set HttpOnly on session and authentication cookies.

name: Unsafe Regex Construction
description: Detects regular expressions dynamically constructed from request input.
recommendation: Validate and constrain user input before constructing regular expressions.

name: Potential LDAP Injection
description: Detects LDAP filter strings concatenated with request input.
recommendation: Escape and validate all user input before constructing LDAP queries.

name: Potential XPath Injection
description: Detects XPath expressions concatenated with request input.
recommendation: Use parameterized XPath queries or strictly validate user input.

name: Unsafe File Deletion
description: Detects file deletion using request-controlled paths.
recommendation: Validate and constrain file paths before deleting files.

name: Hardcoded Session Secret
description: Detects session secrets embedded directly in source code.
recommendation: Store session secrets in environment variables or a secure secrets manager.
